text: China Sports Industry Group (SSE 600158) names the General Administration of Sport of China (国家体育总局) as its ultimate controller; its largest shareholder, the Administration's Sports Fund Management Centre, holds 19.49%. At 30 June 2026 its first, second and fourth largest shareholders (19.49%, 7.01% and 1.33%) were units under the Administration.
short: China Sports Industry Group's ultimate controller is China's General Administration of Sport

source.name: 中体产业集团股份有限公司 (China Sports Industry Group Co., Ltd.): 2026年半年度报告 (2026 half-year report, on cninfo)
source.quote: 本企业最终控制方是国家体育总局。
source.note: Notes on related parties: the parent (母公司) is 国家体育总局体育基金管理中心 with 19.49% of shares and voting rights; 'the ultimate controlling party of the company is the General Administration of Sport'. The 2025 annual report (cninfo, 2026-04-30) names 国家体育总局 as actual controller (实际控制人).

additionalSources.name: 中体产业集团股份有限公司 (China Sports Industry Group Co., Ltd.): 2026年半年度报告摘要 (2026 half-year report summary, on cninfo)
additionalSources.quote: 在公司前十名股东中，第 1、2、4 名股东为国家体育总局下属之事业单位、法人单位。
additionalSources.note: Top-10 shareholder table: 国家体育总局体育基金管理中心 19.49%, 华体集团有限公司 7.01%, 国家体育总局体育器材装备中心 1.33% (all 国有法人).
